recipes.title: 🧈 Paneer Butter Masala
recipes.description: Rich, creamy, and packed with aromatic spices—a vegetarian classic!

ingredients.item: Warm Water (to soak paneer, keeps it soft)
Cashew Nuts (soak in warm water for 15 mins)

instructions: Cut paneer into cubes.
Soak in warm salted water for 10–15 minutes.
Boil tomatoes for 8–10 minutes until skin peels easily.
Peel skins and blend tomatoes + soaked cashews into a smooth paste.
Strain the paste for ultra-smooth gravy (restaurant secret ✔️).
Keep aside.
Heat 1 tbsp oil + 1 tbsp butter in a pan.
Add bay leaf, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves.
Add chopped onion, ginger, garlic, green chilli.
Sauté till onions turn light golden (not dark).
Cool slightly → grind into a smooth paste.
Heat 2 tbsp butter in the same pan.
Add onion paste, cook on medium flame for 5–6 minutes till raw smell goes.
Add turmeric, coriander powder, chilli powders.
Mix well and cook till butter starts releasing.
Add strained tomato-cashew puree.
Cook on low–medium flame for 8–10 minutes.
Stir often to avoid splashing.
Add salt and sugar.
Add water to adjust consistency.
Add paneer cubes.
Simmer for 3–4 minutes only (don't overcook).
Add cream, garam masala, kasuri methi.
Add 1 tbsp butter, mix gently.
Switch off flame.
Serve it hot with roti and rice.

recipes.title: 🍗 Tandoori Chicken
recipes.description: Juicy, flavorful chicken marinated in yogurt and spices, grilled to perfection—a North Indian classic!
instructions: Make deep cuts in the chicken pieces to allow marinade to penetrate.
Rub chicken with lemon juice and salt.
Let it rest for 20 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, tandoori masala, red chili powder, turmeric, garam masala, cumin, and oil.
Mix until smooth and well combined.
Add chicken to the marinade and coat well.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
👉 For best results, marinate overnight (8-12 hours).
Preheat grill or oven to 200°C (400°F).
Place chicken on a baking tray lined with foil.
Brush with oil to prevent drying.
Grill or bake for 35-40 minutes, turning halfway.
👉 Chicken should be charred on outside, juicy inside.
Garnish with lemon wedges and sliced onions.
Serve hot with mint chutney and naan.

recipes.title: 🍲 Dal Tadka
recipes.description: Comforting yellow lentils tempered with aromatic spices—the soul of Indian home cooking!
instructions: Rinse lentils thoroughly until water runs clear.
Soak for 15 minutes (optional but helps cook faster).
In a pressure cooker, add lentils, water, turmeric, and salt.
Cook for 3-4 whistles until soft and mushy.
Mash the dal lightly with a spoon. Set aside.
Heat ghee in a pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and mustard seeds—let them crackle.
Add dried red chilies and minced garlic.
Sauté for 30 seconds until garlic turns golden.
Add sliced onions and cook until golden brown.
Add chopped tomatoes and green chili.
Cook until tomatoes soften and oil separates.
Add red chili powder and garam masala. Mix well.
Pour this tadka over the cooked dal.
Mix gently and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Adjust salt and consistency with water if needed.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves.
Serve hot with steamed rice or roti.

recipes.title: 🌮 Spicy Chicken Tacos
recipes.description: A fusion favorite with Indian spice twist on a Mexican classic—bold, flavorful, and fun!
instructions: In a bowl, mix chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, and all spices.
Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes.
👉 For best flavor, marinate for 2 hours in refrigerator.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add marinated chicken and spread in single layer.
Cook for 12-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Chicken should be fully cooked and slightly charred.
Warm taco shells or tortillas in a dry pan.
Or heat in oven at 350°F for 5 minutes.
Place spiced chicken in taco shells.
Top with shredded lettuce and diced tomatoes.
Add sliced onions.
Drizzle with sour cream or yogurt.
Garnish with fresh cilantro.
Serve immediately with lime wedges.

recipes.title: 🍛 Butter Chicken
recipes.description: Creamy, mildly spiced tomato-based curry with tender chicken pieces—India's most beloved dish worldwide!
instructions: Mix chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, chili powder, garam masala, and salt.
Cover and refrigerate for minimum 30 minutes.
👉 Overnight marination gives best results.
Heat 2 tbsp butter in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add marinated chicken pieces.
Cook until golden brown on all sides, about 8-10 minutes.
Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add remaining butter.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 1 minute.
Add tomato puree and cook for 10-12 minutes.
Stir occasionally until oil separates.
Add red chili powder, garam masala, and salt.
Mix well and cook for 2 minutes.
Add cooked chicken and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and kasuri methi.
Add honey to balance the tanginess.
Simmer for 5 more minutes until gravy thickens.
Garnish with a swirl of cream and butter.
Serve hot with naan or basmati rice.

recipes.title: 🥬 Palak Paneer
recipes.description: Fresh spinach curry with soft paneer cubes—healthy, vibrant, and absolutely delicious!
instructions: Boil water in a large pot.
Add spinach and blanch for 2-3 minutes until wilted.
Immediately transfer to ice water to retain green color.
Drain and blend with green chilies into smooth puree.
👉 This step keeps the palak vibrant green!
Heat oil in a pan.
Lightly fry paneer cubes until golden on all sides.
Remove and soak in warm water to keep soft.
Heat oil/ghee in the same pan.
Add cumin seeds and let them crackle.
Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add the spinach puree and bring to a boil.
Add garam masala and salt. Mix well.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add fried paneer cubes and heavy cream.
Simmer for 3-4 minutes. Don't overcook!
Serve hot with roti or rice.

recipes.title: 🍚 Vegetable Biryani
recipes.description: Aromatic basmati rice layered with spiced vegetables—a complete festive meal!
instructions: Soak basmati rice for 30 minutes. Drain.
Boil water with whole spices and salt.
Add rice and cook until 70% done (rice should still have bite).
Drain and set aside.
Soak saffron strands in warm milk.
Keep aside for 10 minutes.
Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pot.
Fry sliced onions until deep golden brown.
Remove half for garnish. Keep remaining in pot.
Add ginger-garlic paste to fried onions. Sauté 1 minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add mixed vegetables, biryani masala, chili powder, yogurt, and salt.
Cook for 10-12 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Spread cooked vegetables at the bottom of the pot.
Layer the partially cooked rice on top.
Sprinkle with mint, coriander, and fried onions.
Drizzle saffron milk over the rice.
Cover with tight-fitting lid or seal with dough.
Cook on high heat for 3 minutes.
Reduce to low heat and cook for 20-25 minutes.
Let it rest for 5 minutes before opening.
Gently mix layers before serving.
Serve hot with raita and papad.

recipes.title: 🍳 Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.description: Quick and easy Indo-Chinese style fried rice with chicken—perfect for busy weeknights!
instructions: Ensure rice is cold and grains are separated.
Dice all vegetables uniformly for even cooking.
Separate white and green parts of spring onions.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat.
Beat eggs and scramble quickly.
Remove and set aside.
Add 1 tbsp oil to the hot wok.
Add diced chicken and stir-fry until cooked through.
Remove and set aside with eggs.
Add remaining oil to wok.
Add minced garlic and white part of spring onions.
Sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add mixed vegetables and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add cold rice and break any clumps.
Stir-fry on high heat for 3-4 minutes.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, black pepper, and salt.
Toss everything together.
Add cooked chicken and scrambled eggs.
Toss well to combine.
Garnish with green spring onions.
Serve hot immediately.

recipes.title: 🫘 Chana Masala
recipes.description: Spicy chickpea curry packed with flavor—perfect protein-rich vegetarian meal!
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them crackle.
Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown (8-10 minutes).
Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies.
Cook for 1-2 minutes until raw smell disappears.
Add tomato puree and cook for 8-10 minutes.
Stir occasionally until oil separates from masala.
Add coriander powder, red chili powder, turmeric, and salt.
Mix well and cook for 2 minutes.
Add boiled chickpeas with 1 cup of water.
Mix well and bring to a boil.
Mash some chickpeas against the pan to thicken gravy.
Simmer for 10-12 minutes.
Add garam masala and amchur powder.
Mix well and cook for 2 more minutes.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves.
Serve hot with bhature, kulcha, or rice.

recipes.title: 🍗 Chicken Biryani
recipes.description: Fragrant and flavorful rice dish layered with marinated chicken—the ultimate comfort food!

ingredients.item: Whole spices (bay leaf, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves)

instructions: Mix chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, biryani masala, red chili powder, lemon juice, and salt.
Cover and refrigerate for minimum 1 hour.
👉 For best flavor, marinate overnight.
Soak rice for 30 minutes. Drain.
Boil water with whole spices.
Cook rice until 70% done. Drain and set aside.
Soak saffron in warm milk for 10 minutes.

instructions.subheading: 🔹 Step 4: Fry onions and cook chicken

instructions: Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pot.
Fry sliced onions until deep golden brown.
Remove half for garnish.
Add marinated chicken to remaining onions.
Cook for 15 minutes until chicken is 80% done.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook 5 more minutes.
Spread chicken at the bottom of the pot.
Layer partially cooked rice on top.
Sprinkle with mint, coriander, and fried onions.
Drizzle saffron milk over the top.
Add dots of ghee.
Cover pot tightly with foil and lid.
Cook on high heat for 3 minutes.
Reduce to lowest heat and cook for 25-30 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes before opening.
Gently mix layers.
Serve hot with raita and salan.

recipes.title: 🌶️ Pachi Mirchi Paneer Pulao
recipes.description: Aromatic rice cooked with green chilies and paneer—a spicy South Indian delight!

ingredients.item: Whole spices (bay leaf, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves)

instructions: Wash and soak basmati rice for 30 minutes.
Drain and set aside.
Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan.
Lightly fry paneer cubes until golden.
Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add cumin seeds and whole spices.
Let them crackle.
Add sliced onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and slit green chilies.
Sauté for 1-2 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft and mushy.
Add turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt.
Add green peas and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the soaked rice and gently mix.
Sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Add water and half the mint and coriander leaves.
Bring to a boil.
Cover with a tight-fitting lid and cook on low heat for 15-20 minutes.
Add the fried paneer cubes and garam masala.
Gently mix without breaking the rice.
Garnish with remaining mint and coriander leaves.
Serve hot with raita or pickle.

recipes.title: 🍕 Classic Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: Authentic Italian pizza with fresh mozzarella, tomatoes, and basil—simple perfection!
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C).
If using a pizza stone, place it in the oven to heat.
Roll out pizza dough on a floured surface.
Shape into a 12-inch circle.
Transfer to a pizza pan or parchment paper.
Mix tomato sauce with minced garlic, salt, and pepper.
Spread evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border.
Tear or slice fresh mozzarella.
Arrange evenly over the sauce.
Drizzle with olive oil.
Transfer to oven and bake for 12-15 minutes.
Crust should be golden and cheese bubbly.
Remove from oven immediately.
Top with fresh basil leaves.
Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil.
Slice and serve hot.

recipes.title: 🍜 Pad Thai
recipes.description: Popular Thai stir-fried noodles with tamarind sauce and peanuts—street food at its best!
instructions: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 30 minutes.
Drain well and set aside.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, brown sugar, and water.
Stir until sugar dissolves. Set aside.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat.
Add minced garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add chicken or tofu and cook until done.
Push ingredients to the side.
Crack eggs into the wok and scramble.
Add soaked noodles and Pad Thai sauce.
Toss everything together well.
Add bean sprouts and half the green onions.
Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until noodles are coated.
Transfer to serving plates.
Garnish with crushed peanuts and remaining green onions.
Serve with lime wedges on the side.

recipes.title: 🥗 Greek Salad
recipes.description: Fresh Mediterranean salad with feta cheese, olives, and crisp vegetables—healthy and refreshing!
instructions: Wash all vegetables thoroughly.
Chop cucumbers, tomatoes, and bell pepper into bite-sized pieces.
Thinly slice the red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Set aside.
In a large bowl, combine cucumbers, tomatoes, bell pepper, and red onion.
Add Kalamata olives.
Pour dressing over the vegetables.
Toss gently to coat.
Top with cubed feta cheese.
👉 Don't mix the feta in—keep it on top!
Let sit for 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Toss gently before serving.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

recipes.title: 🍝 Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.description: Creamy Italian pasta with bacon, eggs, and Parmesan cheese—Roman classic perfected!
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
In a bowl, whisk together whole eggs, egg yolks, Parmesan cheese, and black pepper.
Mix until smooth and creamy.
Fry guanciale or bacon in a large pan until crispy.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute (optional).
Remove pan from heat.
Add hot drained pasta to the pan with bacon.
Remove pan completely from heat.
Quickly add egg mixture and toss vigorously.
👉 The residual heat will cook the eggs without scrambling.
Add pasta water as needed for creamy consistency.
Season with salt and more pepper if needed.
Garnish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan.
Serve immediately—carbonara doesn't wait!

recipes.title: 🌶️ Kung Pao Chicken
recipes.description: Spicy Sichuan-style stir-fry with chicken, peanuts, and vegetables—bold and addictive!
instructions: Mix chicken with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Let sit for 15 minutes.
Mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, sesame oil, and water.
Stir until smooth. Set aside.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat.
Add dried red chilies and Sichuan peppercorns.
Stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant and slightly charred.
👉 Don't burn the chilies!
Add marinated chicken to the wok.
Stir-fry until cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add ginger and garlic, stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add bell peppers and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the Kung Pao sauce.
Stir until sauce thickens and coats everything.
Add roasted peanuts and green onions.
Toss well to combine.
Serve hot over steamed rice.

recipes.title: 🧆 Falafel
recipes.description: Crispy Middle Eastern chickpea fritters served with tahini sauce—vegan street food perfection!
instructions: Use DRIED chickpeas—not canned!
Soak overnight in plenty of water (they will double in size).
Drain completely before using.
Add soaked chickpeas to food processor.
Add onion, garlic, parsley, and cilantro.
Pulse until coarse mixture forms.
👉 Do NOT puree—texture should be grainy.
Add cumin, coriander, cayenne, salt, and baking powder.
Pulse a few times to combine.
Taste and adjust seasoning.
Transfer to a bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour.
This helps the falafel hold together when frying.
Form mixture into small balls or patties.
Heat oil to 350°F (175°C).
Deep fry falafel in batches for 3-4 minutes.
Fry until deep golden brown on all sides.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with tahini sauce, hummus, or in pita bread.

recipes.title: 🍛 Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.description: Grilled chicken in creamy tomato-based curry sauce—Britain's favorite Indian dish!
instructions: Mix chicken with yogurt, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, turmeric, chili powder, and salt.
Cover and refrigerate for minimum 2 hours.
👉 Overnight marination gives best results.
Thread chicken onto skewers.
Grill or broil until charred and cooked through.
Can also pan-fry in batches.
Set aside.
Heat butter in a large pan.
Add chopped onion and sauté until soft.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook 1 minute.
Add tomato sauce and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir occasionally until slightly thickened.
Add garam masala and mix well.
Add heavy cream and kasuri methi.
Add honey to balance acidity.
Add grilled chicken pieces.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Garnish with cream and fresh coriander.
Serve hot with naan or rice.

recipes.title: 🍜 Ramen
recipes.description: Japanese noodle soup with rich broth and toppings—soul-warming comfort in a bowl!
instructions: Boil eggs for exactly 6-7 minutes.
Transfer to ice water immediately.
Peel and marinate in soy sauce mixture if desired.
Bring broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add soy sauce and miso paste.
Whisk until miso dissolves completely.
Keep warm on low heat.
Slice chashu pork or cook chicken until done.
Set aside.
Cook ramen noodles according to package directions.
Don't overcook—they should be slightly firm.
Drain well.
Divide cooked noodles among 4 bowls.
Pour hot broth over noodles.
Arrange toppings: sliced meat, halved egg, nori, bamboo shoots, corn, and bean sprouts.
Add sliced green onions on top.
Drizzle with sesame oil.
Serve immediately while piping hot.

recipes.title: 🍝 Fettuccine Alfredo
recipes.description: Creamy Italian pasta with Parmesan and butter—simple elegance on a plate!
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil.
Cook fettuccine according to package directions until al dente.
Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Melt butter in large pan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Don't let the garlic brown.
Pour in heavy cream.
Bring to a gentle simmer.
Let it reduce slightly for 2-3 minutes.
Reduce heat to low.
Gradually whisk in Parmesan cheese.
Stir continuously until cheese melts and sauce is smooth.
Season with salt and white pepper.
Add drained pasta to the sauce.
Toss to coat evenly.
Add pasta water if sauce is too thick.
Garnish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan.
Serve immediately while hot and creamy.

recipes.title: 🥟 Samosas
recipes.description: Indian crispy fried pastries filled with spiced potatoes—the ultimate tea-time snack!
instructions: Mix flour, salt, and carom seeds in a bowl.
Add ghee/oil and rub into flour until crumbly.
Add water gradually and knead into a stiff dough.
Cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let them crackle.
Add ginger and green chilies. Sauté for 30 seconds.
Add green peas and cook for 2 minutes.
Add all spices: coriander powder, garam masala, red chili, amchur, and salt.
Mix in mashed potatoes. Cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add chopped coriander. Mix well and let it cool completely.
Divide dough into equal balls.
Roll each ball into an oval shape.
Cut in half to get two semi-circles.
Form each half into a cone shape, sealing the edge with water.
Fill with potato mixture (don't overfill).
Seal the top edge with water, pressing firmly.
Heat oil to 300°F (150°C)—low-medium heat.
👉 Low temperature is the secret to crispy samosas!
Gently slide samosas into oil (don't crowd the pan).
Fry on low heat for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Increase heat to medium and fry until deep golden brown.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with mint chutney and tamarind chutney.

recipes.title: 🌶️ Andhra Tomato Pickle
recipes.description: Spicy and tangy tomato pickle from Andhra Pradesh—perfect with rice and curd!
instructions: Wash and dry tomatoes completely.
Chop into small pieces.
👉 Tomatoes must be dry to prevent pickle from spoiling.
Dry roast fenugreek and mustard seeds separately until fragrant.
Cool and grind to a fine powder.
Set aside.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy-bottomed pan.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook on medium heat.
Stir occasionally until tomatoes become soft and mushy.
Continue cooking until all moisture evaporates (15-20 minutes).
Add turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt.
Mix well and cook for 5 minutes.
Add tamarind paste and mix thoroughly.
Cook for another 5 minutes.
Add peeled garlic cloves.
Add the roasted spice powder.
Mix well and cook for 5 minutes.
Heat remaining oil until smoking.
Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Pour this hot oil over the pickle.
Mix well and let it cool completely.
Store in a clean, dry glass jar.
👉 Pickle tastes better after 2-3 days.

recipes.title: 🍮 Semolina (Rava) Payasam
recipes.description: A rich, creamy South Indian dessert made with roasted semolina, milk, and aromatic cardamom—perfect for festivals!
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp ghee in a heavy-bottom pan.
Add rava and roast on low flame.
Stir continuously for 2–3 minutes until aromatic.
Do NOT brown the rava.
Remove and keep aside.
👉 This step prevents lumps and raw taste.
In the same pan, add water + milk.
Bring to a gentle boil on medium flame.
Lower flame.
Slowly sprinkle roasted rava into the milk while stirring continuously.
Cook for 3–4 minutes until rava softens and thickens.
👉 Stir constantly — rava thickens quickly.
Add sugar and mix well.
Cook for 2 minutes until sugar dissolves.
Payasam will slightly thin after adding sugar — this is normal.
Heat remaining 1 tbsp ghee in a small pan.
Fry cashews till golden.
Add raisins and switch off once they puff.
Add to payasam.
Add cardamom powder and saffron.
Add edible camphor ONLY if using (tiny pinch).
Mix gently and switch off flame.

recipes.title: 🥘 Hyderabadi Haleem
recipes.description: Rich, slow-cooked meat and lentil stew—a Ramadan specialty from Hyderabad!
instructions: Wash and soak all dals and broken wheat for 2 hours.
Drain before cooking.
In a pressure cooker, add meat, soaked lentils, wheat, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, and salt.
Add 6 cups water.
Pressure cook for 45 minutes until everything is very soft.
Once cooled, shred the meat and mash everything together.
Use a wooden paddle (khunti) or hand blender.
The texture should be porridge-like but chunky.
Heat ghee in a large pot.
Fry sliced onions until deep golden.
Add green chilies and mint leaves.
Add haleem masala, red chili powder, and garam masala.
Sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the shredded meat-lentil mixture to the pot.
Mix well and cook on low heat for 30-45 minutes.
Stir frequently to prevent sticking.
Add water if needed to adjust consistency.
Garnish with fried onions, julienned ginger, fresh coriander, and mint.
Serve hot with lemon wedges and naan.

recipes.title: 🍩 Gulab Jamun
recipes.description: Soft, melt-in-mouth milk dumplings soaked in rose-scented sugar syrup—India's most loved dessert!
instructions: Combine sugar and water in a pan.
Add crushed cardamom and bring to boil.
Simmer for 5-7 minutes until slightly sticky.
Add rose water and saffron. Keep warm.
Crumble khoya in a bowl.
Add flour and baking soda.
Add milk gradually and knead into smooth, soft dough.
👉 Don't overknead—dough should be crack-free.
Rest for 10 minutes.
Divide dough into small portions.
Roll each into smooth, crack-free balls.
👉 Cracks will cause jamuns to break while frying.
Heat ghee on LOW heat (crucial!).
Test: drop a small piece—it should rise slowly.
Gently slide jamun balls into ghee.
Fry on low heat, turning constantly.
Fry until deep golden brown (10-12 minutes).
👉 High heat = raw inside, burnt outside!
Transfer hot jamuns directly into warm syrup.
Let them soak for at least 2 hours.
They will absorb syrup and become soft.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
Garnish with chopped pistachios and rose petals.

recipes.title: ☕ Masala Chai
recipes.description: Aromatic Indian spiced tea with ginger and cardamom—the perfect pick-me-up!
instructions: Add water to a saucepan.
Add crushed ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, pepper, and cloves.
Bring to a rolling boil.
Let it boil for 2 minutes to extract flavors.
Add tea leaves to the boiling water.
Boil for 1-2 minutes until water turns dark.
Pour in the milk.
Bring to a boil again.
Let it simmer for 2-3 minutes.
👉 Watch carefully—it can boil over quickly!
Add sugar and stir well.
Strain into cups using a tea strainer.
Serve hot with biscuits or pakoras.
Best enjoyed on a rainy day! ☔

recipes.title: 🥐 Classic Butter Croissants
recipes.description: Flaky, buttery French pastries with perfectly laminated layers—bakery-quality at home!
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in a bowl.
Add cold milk and 30g soft butter.
Knead until smooth dough forms (5-7 minutes).
Wrap in plastic and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Place 280g butter between parchment paper.
Pound and roll into a 15x15cm square.
Keep refrigerated until firm but pliable.
Roll dough into a rectangle (30x20cm).
Place butter block in center.
Fold dough over butter like an envelope.
Roll out and fold into thirds (first turn).
Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Repeat rolling and folding 2 more times.
👉 Total 3 turns with 30-min rest between each.
Roll dough to 5mm thickness.
Cut into triangles (base 10cm, height 20cm).
Make a small notch at base center.
Roll from base to tip, curving ends.
Place on baking tray, seam-side down.
Cover and proof at room temperature for 2 hours.
Croissants should double in size and feel light.
Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Brush with egg wash (egg + milk).
Bake for 15-18 minutes until deep golden.
Cool on rack before serving.

recipes.title: 🍞 Homemade Garlic Bread
recipes.description: Crispy on the outside, soft and garlicky inside—the perfect side for pasta and soups!
instructions: Mix softened butter with minced garlic.
Add chopped parsley, salt, and Italian herbs.
Mix until well combined.
Cut baguette in half lengthwise.
Or slice diagonally without cutting through bottom.
Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).
Spread garlic butter generously on cut sides.
If sliced, push butter between slices.
Add shredded cheese if desired.
Wrap in aluminum foil (for soft bread).
Or leave open (for crispy bread).
Bake for 10-12 minutes wrapped.
Open foil and bake 3-5 more minutes for crispness.
Slice if needed and serve immediately.
Perfect alongside pasta, soup, or salads!

recipes.title: 🧁 Classic Chocolate Cupcakes
recipes.description: Moist chocolate cupcakes topped with silky chocolate buttercream—perfect for celebrations!
instructions: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F).
Line muffin tin with cupcake liners.
Sift flour, cocoa, sugar, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk eggs, buttermilk, oil, and vanilla.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients.
Mix until just combined.
Add hot coffee and stir until smooth.
👉 Batter will be thin—this is correct!
Fill cupcake liners 2/3 full.
Bake for 18-22 minutes.
Test with toothpick—should come out clean.
Cool completely before frosting.
Beat softened butter until fluffy (3 minutes).
Add powdered sugar and cocoa gradually.
Add cream and vanilla, beat until smooth.
If too thick, add more cream. If too thin, add more sugar.
Pipe or spread frosting on cooled cupcakes.
Decorate with sprinkles or chocolate shavings.
Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: 🥖 Rustic Focaccia Bread
recipes.description: Pillowy Italian flatbread with olive oil, rosemary, and sea salt—irresistibly delicious!
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Let sit 5 minutes.
Add flour, salt, and olive oil.
Mix until shaggy dough forms.
Knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in oiled bowl.
Cover and let rise for 1-1.5 hours until doubled.
Pour 2 tbsp olive oil in a 9x13 inch baking pan.
Transfer dough to pan.
Gently stretch dough to fill pan.
If dough springs back, let it rest 10 minutes and try again.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Dough should be puffy and fill the pan.
Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F).
Dip fingers in olive oil.
Press fingertips into dough creating dimples.
Drizzle remaining olive oil over top.
Press rosemary, tomatoes, and olives into dimples.
Sprinkle with flaky sea salt.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
Cool slightly before slicing.
Best served warm!

recipes.title: 🍪 Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Perfectly chewy cookies with crispy edges and gooey chocolate chips—the ultimate comfort treat!
instructions: Whisk flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl.
Set aside.
Beat softened butter with both sugars.
Beat for 3-4 minutes until light and fluffy.
👉 This step is key for chewy texture!
Add eggs one at a time, beating after each.
Add vanilla extract and mix well.
Gradually add dry ingredients to wet.
Mix until just combined—don't overmix!
Fold in chocolate chips.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
👉 Chilling prevents spreading and improves flavor.
Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).
Scoop dough balls onto lined baking sheet.
Space 2 inches apart.
Sprinkle with flaky sea salt.
Bake 9-11 minutes until edges are golden but centers look underdone.
Let cool on pan for 5 minutes—they'll firm up!
Best served warm with a glass of cold milk! 🥛

recipes.title: 🥧 Classic Apple Pie
recipes.description: Homemade apple pie with flaky butter crust and cinnamon-spiced filling—American comfort at its best!
instructions: Pulse flour, sugar, and salt in food processor.
Add cold cubed butter and pulse until pea-sized crumbs.
Add ice water 1 tbsp at a time until dough comes together.
Divide into 2 discs, wrap, and chill for 1 hour.
Toss sliced apples with sugars, cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon juice, and cornstarch.
Let sit 30 minutes to release juices.
Roll one disc to 12-inch circle on floured surface.
Transfer to 9-inch pie dish.
Trim edges, leaving 1-inch overhang.
Refrigerate while preparing top crust.
Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Add apple filling to crust, mounding in center.
Dot with butter pieces.
Roll second disc for top crust.
Place over filling and crimp edges.
Cut 4-5 slits for steam to escape.
Beat egg with cream.
Brush over top crust.
Sprinkle with sugar if desired.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Reduce to 175°C (350°F) and bake 35-40 more minutes.
Crust should be golden, filling bubbling.
Cover edges with foil if browning too fast.
Cool at least 2 hours before slicing.
Serve with vanilla ice cream! 🍨

recipes.title: 🍳 Masala Dosa
recipes.description: Crispy South Indian crepe filled with spiced potato masala—a breakfast favorite across India!
instructions: Grind soaked rice with fenugreek to smooth batter.
Grind urad dal separately to fluffy batter.
Mix both batters with salt.
Ferment overnight in warm place (8-12 hours).
Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds.
When they splutter, add urad dal and curry leaves.
Add ginger, green chilies, and onions.
Sauté until onions are translucent.
Add turmeric and mashed potatoes.
Mix well, add salt, and cook 5 minutes.
Add coriander leaves. Keep warm.
Heat a flat griddle (tawa) on medium-high.
Pour a ladleful of batter in center.
Spread in circular motion to thin crepe.
Drizzle oil around edges.
Cook until bottom is golden and crispy.
Place potato masala in center of dosa.
Fold dosa over the filling.
Serve immediately.
Serve with coconut chutney and sambar.
Dosas taste best hot off the griddle!

recipes.title: 🥤 Mango Lassi
recipes.description: Creamy Indian yogurt smoothie with ripe mangoes—refreshing and naturally sweet!
instructions: Peel and chop fresh mango into chunks.
If using frozen, no need to thaw.
Add mango, yogurt, milk, and sugar to blender.
Add ice cubes.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust sweetness.
Pour into tall glasses.
Sprinkle with cardamom powder.
Add saffron strands and chopped pistachios.
Serve immediately while cold! 🥭

recipes.title: 🍲 Aloo Gobi
recipes.description: Classic Indian dry curry with potatoes and cauliflower—simple, comforting, and flavorful!
instructions: Wash and cut cauliflower into medium florets.
Peel and cube potatoes.
Pat dry both vegetables.
Heat oil in a large pan or kadai.
Add cumin seeds and let them crackle.
Add sliced onions and sauté until light golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies.
Sauté for 1 minute.
Add potatoes first, cook for 5 minutes.
Add cauliflower florets.
Add turmeric, coriander powder, red chili powder, and salt.
Mix well to coat vegetables.
Cover and cook on low-medium heat for 15-20 minutes.
Stir occasionally. Add splash of water if needed.
Once vegetables are tender, add garam masala and amchur.
Mix gently—don't break the florets.
Garnish with fresh coriander.
Serve hot with roti or paratha.

recipes.title: 🥮 Naan Bread
recipes.description: Soft, fluffy Indian leavened bread—perfect for scooping up curries!
instructions: Mix warm milk with sugar and yeast.
Let sit for 5-10 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
Add yeast mixture, yogurt, and oil.
Knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth and soft.
Cover and let rise for 1-2 hours until doubled.
Divide dough into 8 equal portions.
Roll each into oval or teardrop shape (about 6-7 inches).
Keep thickness around 3-4mm.
Heat cast iron skillet or tawa on high.
Place naan on dry hot skillet.
Cook until bubbles form and bottom has brown spots.
Flip and cook other side.
Or hold with tongs over direct flame for char marks.
Brush hot naan with melted butter.
Add minced garlic and cilantro for garlic naan.
Serve immediately with curry or dal.
